housing: Uttlesford is a rural district in north-west Essex with high house prices and a private renting share well below the national average. Saffron Walden, Thaxted and many villages have listed timber-framed, thatched and pargeted houses. Stansted Airport is a major employer, and new-build estates at Great Dunmow, Takeley and Elsenham house many airport and commuter households. Many rural homes rely on oil heating.
checkinTips: Timber-framed and thatched cottages: photograph beams, thatch, low doorways and any cracks or damp in plaster.
Rural homes off the gas grid: record the oil tank, fuel level, septic tank or private drainage and the boiler service label.
New-build homes in Great Dunmow, Takeley and Elsenham: note snagging marks, fences, turf and management company areas.
Homes under the Stansted flight path: note window types and any secondary glazing or noise insulation supplied.
Listed homes in Saffron Walden and Thaxted: photograph original windows, doors and fittings, as changes need consent.
tenantHelp: Private tenants can contact Uttlesford District Council's Environmental Health team about disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions.
